Physiotherapy Management
• •Stretching Exercises: Focus on stretching the calf muscles and
plantar fascia to improve flexibility.
• •Strengthening Exercises: Strengthening exercises for the foot and
lower leg muscles to support the arch.
• •Manual Therapy: Techniques to relieve tension in the fascia and
improve range of motion.
• •Ice Therapy: Application of ice to reduce inflammation and pain.
• •Footwear Assessment: Guidance on appropriate footwear to
provide proper support.
• •Orthotics: Custom or over-the-counter orthotic devices to support
the arch and relieve pressure.
• •Activity Modification: Educating patients on avoiding activities that
exacerbate symptoms.
(NSAIDs)
Medical Management
• •Medications: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) to
relieve pain and inflammation.
• •Corticosteroid Injections: Injections at the affected site to reduce
inflammation.
•Surgery: Considered for severe cases that do not respond to
conservative treatments.
